why: 12,279 cumulative DEV trials on 2021-2025 Binance data push the chance bar to SR 2.51. Selecting K=5 candidates now and testing only them on unseen data charges the confirmation for K=5, not 12,279 (ADR 0055/0059 reasoning). Winner's curse: these are the best of 63 loop trials, so their DEV numbers overstate them.

candidates_fixed.CL1: ADR 0106 CL1_CLOSE_LOCATION_U50 exactly (run/newsrc_r11_dev.py compute: 14-day mean (2c-h-l)/(h-l), long top quintile, short bottom)
candidates_fixed.FIP1: ADR 0107 FIP1_FROGPAN_U50 exactly (run/newsrc_r12_dev.py frog: z(PRET90) - z(ID90), long top quintile, short bottom)
candidates_fixed.DS1: ADR 0107 DS1_DISPERSION_U50 exactly (dispersion_on: long equal-weight universe when 14-day mean cross-sectional stdev < its 180-day rolling median, else flat)
candidates_fixed.COMBO: equal-weight (1/4 each, re-set every rebalance) of the four candidates' target weights, netted per name; decided now, before any confirmation data

stage_1_IW0.data: project file data/pre2020_spot_binance_15m_UNREAD.zip (sha256 2044f436...ddf484, ADR 0059): 31 Binance spot symbols, 15m bars 2017-08..2019-12, aggregated to UTC daily open/high/low/close/quote volume/trade count. Read once.
stage_1_IW0.limits: spot: no funding (AF1 not testable here), shorts not tradable (long-short legs are a paper statistic only), cost only assumed
stage_1_IW0.universe: every symbol with >= 60 daily bars at cut i-2 and 30-day mean quote volume >= 1M USDT; no top-50 cap (at most 31 names). Quintile size k = floor(n/5); a rebalance with n < 10 is flat.
stage_1_IW0.eval_window: first Monday-grid rebalance on or after 2018-06-04 (monthly symbol count reaches 11-17) to 2019-12-31; reads from 2017-08-01 for lookbacks
stage_1_IW0.rebalance: 14 days on a Monday grid anchored 2018-06-04; trade at the daily open of day i, signal at cut i-2; weights drift
stage_1_IW0.cost: assumed 15 bp per unit of one-way turnover (10 bp taker + 5 bp spread/impact), and a x2 stress row

tests.DS1_IW0: net daily return of the long/flat timing rule (tradable on spot)
tests.CL1_IW0: net daily return of (top quintile long) minus (equal-weight eligible universe) = paper relative statistic
tests.FIP1_IW0: same construction as CL1_IW0 with the FIP1 signal
tests.COMBO_IW0: equal-weight average of the three daily series above

stage_1_IW0.decision: one-sided Newey-West (lag 14) t of mean net daily return > 0; Holm step-down over the 4 tests at family alpha 0.05. A test PASSES only if Holm-significant AND net SR > 0 in both calendar halves of the eval window AND the x2 cost row is > 0. Everything else is FAIL. No re-runs, no parameter change, no symbol change after opening.
stage_1_IW0.power_note: eval window ~1.6 years with 11-31 names; a true net SR 1.0 gives t ~1.3, so this stage is likely to FAIL even for a real edge (low power, stated before opening)

implementation.daily_bars: UTC day: open = first 15m open, high = max, low = min, close = last close, quote volume and trade count = sums; rows at or after 2020-01-01 are dropped before anything else (asserted)
implementation.returns: open of day d to open of day d+1; last eval day 2019-12-30 (its return ends at the 2019-12-31 open); missing return of a held name counts as 0 and is reported
implementation.cost_turnover: for CL1/FIP1 the turnover is that of the NET weight vector (top quintile long minus equal-weight universe), times 15 bp (x2 row 30 bp); DS1 the long/flat equal-weight vector
implementation.halves: the eval days split into two equal-count halves
implementation.lookback_gate: a rebalance with cut < 192 days after 2017-08-01 or fewer than 10 eligible names is flat for all tests

stage_2_forward.what: all five candidates on the live U50 universe via the existing paper-forward pipeline (ADR 0073-0077 integrity rules), real funding, calibrated cost
stage_2_forward.statistic: per-block e-value product (ADR 0025 v3 approach) with capped block loss; promotion still needs every existing gate (VERIFIED cost from real fills, DSR/CI promo-v5)
stage_2_forward.status: plan only; needs its own activation by the user
